name: Conflicto Armado
storyline: Colombia, 1985. A patrol arrives three days late to an empty village. Over three decades the same characters cross paths with guerrillas, paramilitaries, drug traffickers and the army, until the peace process of 2016. Events and places are inspired by real history; names are invented and no real massacres or victims are recreated.
summary: Conflicto Armado is a turn-based tactics and stealth game set during Colombia's armed conflict, from 1985 to 2016, told from the middle ground: soldiers, farmers, victims and people who just want to get out alive. Lead Corporal Wilson's squad tile by tile through jungle, river, paramo and city across 38 missions in four acts: escort a boat full of medicine, find a car bomb in twelve turns, protect a witness in Medellin, slip alone into a camp to rescue hostages. Choices change the ending. Includes online co-op for Act I and a free 3-mission prologue.
